items.stem: Where is Fabric Data Warehouse data physically stored?

options.rationale: Correct: warehouse data, like all Fabric data, is stored in Delta tables on OneLake.

options.text: In a proprietary row store only the warehouse can read
options.rationale: Fabric uses the open Delta format, not a closed proprietary store.
Data is persisted in Delta tables, not held only in memory.

options.text: In a separate Azure SQL Database
options.rationale: The warehouse stores data in OneLake, not an external Azure SQL Database.
